speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to help me understand what is causing this, please tell me if the rash is present at birth or if it appeared later, and whether it is itchy or painful. Also, has anyone noticed any fever, poor feeding, or changes in your behavior?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Rash (likely disseminated gonococcal infection presenting as purulent pustules).

REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Gram_Stain_of_Pus, CSF_Analysis.
REQUEST IMAGES: Close-up dermoscopic view of the rash and any joint swelling.
